event_text: A group calling itself the Handsome Boy Hacking Club posts a screenshot of what it says are FIFA files
notes: The Associated Press says this happened 'last week' in its Nov 26 report; it gives no exact day. Three days later the group appeared to take credit.

event_text: FIFA confirms to The Record that hackers got unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information
FIFA's statement is reported by The Associated Press and Al Jazeera, among others
